page.title: Finance
page.holdsEmpty: No booking holds need manual settlement.

filters.holdsSearchPlaceholder: XPH code, customer name, shop name

settle.title: Settle booking hold {code}
settle.noteRequired: A reason is required (at least 5 characters).

reason.dispute_open: This booking has an open dispute - read and resolve the dispute case before settling the money.
reason.handover_unconfirmed: Pickup time has passed but the owner has not confirmed the handover, so the system opened a handover check case. Nobody has filed a complaint: contact the owner and the customer, then record the trip verdict on the support case. The money settles from that verdict.
reason.booking_ended: The booking has ended but its outcome was not settled automatically (usually because a case was open when it ended). Read the case conclusion, then settle.

settle.auditHint: This action is written to the audit log and cannot be undone.
settle.confirmHint: The outcome "{outcome}" will be settled and the money allocated right away. The reason is written to the audit log under your name.
settle.notePlaceholder: e.g. the dispute was resolved in the customer's favour, refund in full
settle.chooseHint: Pick an outcome on the right - preview who receives what before settling.
settle.previewEmpty: Choose an outcome to see who receives what.
settle.noAllocation: Legacy hold - this outcome is recorded only; no money is allocated.

outcomeHelp.settled: Trip completed: deposit to the owner (after tax), fee to XePrime, insurance to the insurer.
outcomeHelp.split_late_cancel: Late cancellation or no-show: the owner's share of the reservation payment to the owner, platform fee and commission to XePrime (less any promo funding), insurance refunded to the customer.
outcomeHelp.refunded: Refund the customer everything they transferred.
outcomeHelp.kept: Trip ran: the platform keeps the amount; nothing is transferred.
outcomeHelp.forfeited: Late cancellation or no-show: the amount goes to the shop wallet as compensation.
outcomeHelp.released_to_shop: Trip completed: the amount is returned to the shop wallet.

settle.taxWithheld: Within the owner's share: tax withheld on completion

refundPaid.title: Record refund transfer
refundPaid.noAccount: The customer has not provided a refund account yet - cannot transfer.

reject.title: Reject refund
reject.noteRequired: A reason is required (at least 5 characters).
reject.audienceHint: The customer will read this reason.

reconciliation.varianceHint: The bank balance does not match the two sides. Check the unmatched incoming queue, manual transfers not yet recorded, and the balance you entered.
reconciliation.walletDriftWarning: Ledger drift in {count, plural, one {# wallet} other {# wallets}} · {amount} total
reconciliation.walletDriftHint: Wallet ledger entries do not add up to the stored balance. That means something writes balances outside the ledger - stop payouts and investigate before spending further.
reconciliation.subscriptionsUnappliedNote: Underpaid invoices and overpayments from before automatic wallet credit
reconciliation.matchedWalletCredits: Late payments refunded to customer wallets

tax.title: Tax ledger by period
tax.loadError: Could not load the tax ledger

byEntity.title: By entity type
byEntity.valueSplit: {amount} (VAT {vat} · PIT {pit}) · {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

unknownWarning.title: Some obligations belong to shops with no seller profile
unknownWarning.body: These rows were still withheld at the individual rate - a missing profile never removes the obligation - but the return needs the seller’s entity type and tax ID or personal ID number. Ask those shops to complete their profile before closing the period - do not file them under individuals yourself, which would be guessing at a legal obligation on their behalf.

actions.declaredDone: Recorded the whole period as declared
actions.remittedDone: Recorded the whole period as paid

empty.title: No obligations in this period
empty.description: Tax only accrues once a trip has started - trips cancelled before pickup have no row.

reverseModal.title: Reverse a tax row
reverseModal.hint: Reversing writes a NEGATIVE row pointing at the original; it never edits the old figure. Afterwards the booking can record the correct obligation again. Remitted rows cannot be reversed - use an amended return.

filing.title: Declaration and payment evidence
filing.legacyDeclared: This period was declared before evidence was tracked - you can add the declaration number now.
filing.mismatch: The amount paid differs from the ledger total ({ledger})

declareDialog.title: Record declaration for {period}
declareDialog.hint: This moves every undeclared row of the period to declared and saves the declaration number as evidence. Each period is recorded once.
declareDialog.refHint: The number issued by the tax authority when the return is filed.
declareDialog.dateRange: The date must be between {from} and today

remitDialog.title: Record tax payment for {period}
remitDialog.hint: This moves every declared row of the period to paid and saves the payment receipt as evidence. Each period is recorded once.
remitDialog.ledger: Tax on the ledger for this period
remitDialog.noteRequired: The amount paid differs from the ledger total - add a note explaining it
remitDialog.mismatch: The amount paid differs from the ledger total {ledger}. You can still record it, but a note is required.

status.walletDrift: Ledger drift in {count, plural, one {# wallet} other {# wallets}}

gateway.emptyDescription: Payments the gateway reported but the system could not record automatically appear here.

filters.searchPlaceholder: XPG/XPH code, order ref or gateway transaction id

detail.title: Gateway payment
detail.rawHint: Signature removed. Use this as evidence when reconciling with the gateway.
detail.rawEmpty: The gateway has not reported a result yet.

footer.open: Reconcile with the gateway portal before closing.
footer.handled: This payment is no longer in the queue.

requery.changed: The gateway has a new result. This payment was updated.
requery.noChange: Nothing new from the gateway for this payment.
requery.unreachable: Could not reach the gateway right now. Try again in a few minutes.

resolve.title: Close gateway payment
resolve.body: Record what you did (for example, refunded manually through the gateway portal). This button moves no money.
resolve.notePlaceholder: E.g. Refunded 300,000 VND through the MoMo portal, refund ref …
resolve.refundReferenceRequired: Enter the refund reference (at least 3 characters).

apply.title: Record a collected gateway payment
apply.summary: {amount} will be applied to {code} as a real payment: an invoice may activate a plan, a booking hold may create a booking. Only do this after checking the gateway portal and confirming this payment has NOT been refunded.
apply.notePlaceholder: E.g. MoMo portal confirms transaction …, not refunded

events.title: Gateway result log ({count, number})
events.empty: The gateway has not reported any result yet.

effect.duplicate_provider_tx: transaction id used by another payment

scheduledCredits.title: Pending wallet credits ({count})
scheduledCredits.hint: When a guest cancels or does not show up, the guest refund and the owner share wait (see App configuration) before reaching the wallet. Hold credits under dispute; release once verified.

actions.unfreezeSuccess: Hold removed - the credit waits until its original time
actions.releaseConfirmBody: {amount} will reach the wallet of {payee} right now. This cannot be undone.

freeze.title: Hold a pending credit
freeze.notePlaceholder: e.g. the owner reports the guest cancelled and rebooked directly; verifying

bankChangeRequests.title: Payout account change requests ({count})
bankChangeRequests.hint: Payout accounts are locked after first setup. Call the requester, read the new account number back so they confirm it is really them, then approve - only approval switches the account.
bankChangeRequests.noPhone: No phone number - contact by email

approve.title: Approve payout account change
approve.hint: New account: {account} - {name}. Approve only after calling and the person confirms they are the account owner.
approve.notePlaceholder: e.g. called the registered number, name and last 4 ID digits match
approve.noteRequired: Record how you verified (at least 5 characters).

reject.title: Reject account change
reject.notePlaceholder: e.g. the person answering was not the account owner
reject.success: Rejected - the account stays the same
